name: Not sure what to wear? 3 looks
summary: A stylist answers the outfit question for an occasion with three looks, one per moment of the day.
hooks: Pooja, family lunch or the party — confused what to wear?
Festive season aa gaya, outfit decide nahi hua? Let me help.

shots.shows: A woman beside a pile of outfits, unsure, looking at the camera
Look 1 worn full length, for the first moment of the occasion
Look 2 worn full length with a jewellery close-up
Look 3 worn full length, a twirl or a turn
All three looks side by side as a flat lay with prices

caption: Save this for your festive calendar — which look is yours?
why: Solves the shopper's decision before pitching.
